children.text: Part 4 of 5 of an interview with Dr. Américo Paredes. Dr. Paredes discusses working with Dr. Robert King, founder and dean of the College of Liberal Arts at the University of Texas at Austin, to find professors to direct the Ethnic Studies program. Dr. Paredes also highlights the importance of children leaning about their culture and language, his current projects, and favorite corridos.
